title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 27-Inch Solid Brass Euro Hook | Mediterranean Blue | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add flexible toilet paper storage to your bathroom without drilling by choosing this freestanding toilet tissue stand with a European style hook and a stable, heavy base in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction: built for enduring strength
  • Stable base: heavy base helps prevent tipping
  • Coordinated look: designed to pair with matching pieces in the Carolina collection

Specs

  • Category: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stands
  • Collection: Carolina
  • Style: Traditional (with a transitional, versatile look)
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions: 27 in H x 8 in L x 6 in W
  • Weight: 5.6 lb
  • Assembly required: Yes
  • Included items: Toilet tissue stand
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Multiple designer finish options are available to help coordinate with your transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.
